[[File:Lukaze_Four.png|thumb|right|250px|A starfighter equipped with the Lukaze Four system]]
The '''Lukaze Four engine and thruster system''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine and thruster system produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Named after the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ne'wha Lukaze]], the system included retro thrusters that permitted ships to accelerate in reverse for a brief period of [[Time/Legends|time]]&mdash;thus flying directly backwards briefly before resuming its original course.
